name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: prefix data_fd2_, domain 'chapter' (per-chapter cutscene events driven by chapter_NN_init/end + per_chapter_post_action_handler), descriptor 'cutscene_event_script_ptr_table' reflects both purpose (cutscene/walk-animation event scripts) and data type (pointer table). The '_106' suffix is the array dimension (106 entries = event_id 0..105), NOT a Ghidra address residue: 0x627D8 has no relation to 106, and 106 == 0x6A == the documented event_id count and the declared [106] size. Per the naming rule, dimension counts are meaningful domain values and must be preserved. Keep.
purpose: Per-chapter cutscene / walk-animation event script pointer table; indexed by event_id (0..105) to obtain the pointer to that event's walk-animation byte-script.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_get_cutscene_event_script(event_id) returns table[event_id] (disasm: MOV EAX,[event_id*4 + 0x627D8]). The returned pointer is then walked byte-by-byte by fd2_cutscene_event_trigger as a walk-animation byte-script ([n_groups][group: walk_count_or_flags | step_count | {char_idx,dir}*step_count]+, 3 modes by walk_count_or_flags bit7). All 106 entries point into one contiguous byte-stream block stored immediately after the table in .object3 (0x62980..0x634D1, 2898 bytes, = end of .object3). Source emits the byte-stream block (static cutscene_event_script_data[2898]) plus this table referencing offsets into it (Layer-2-equivalent).
element_semantics: Each element is a const uint8 * pointing into the contiguous cutscene-event byte-stream; element[event_id] is the start of that event's walk-animation script, consumed byte-by-byte (every consumer reads bytes, so element type is byte-pointer).
notes: Verified read-only: only one xref to 0x627D8 (DATA read from 0x4E801 in fd2_get_cutscene_event_script), zero game-side write-xref; src declares const. Ghidra datatype confirmed pointer[106] len=424. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created a concise plate (src conclusion as authority). Source comment block (chtab3.c lines 74-82) already accurate and precise (purpose, indexing by event_id 0..105, byte-stream layout 0x62980..0x634D1 / 2898 bytes, const uint8 * element type, read-only) -> kept, no src edit. KB chapter docs (chapter_01.md etc.) reference the name with _106 verbatim; renaming would be disruptive and is unwarranted.
